integrity: The complete parameter-domain and threshold-boundary proofs are analytic, supported by exact symbolic calculations. Independent scientific verification has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Local modes, not global-height orderings or detectable subpopulations. Exact thresholds only for the stated cubic beta-skew-Laplace tilt; no extension is claimed to exponentiated models. Literature comparisons are not a proof of historical uniqueness.
title: Exact one-, two-, and three-mode transitions in beta-skew-Laplace densities
